Compared docs/LANGUAGE-DRAFT.md, docs/RUST-GOALS.md, docs/reviews/CHAT9-REVIEW.md and the language acceptance/review/handoff JSON with c2ae6edb: byte-identical. The historical acceptance receipt remains explicitly bound to its original 498f0f5a source, rather than being falsely rebound to this documentation commit.

Verified current tree has zero tracked .task files and no .task directory, _zil_goal.md, data/task-index.json, data/handoff.json or data/construction-progress.json. The 14 formal engineering contracts and data/requirement-coverage.json are byte-identical to reviewed 9aa32760.

Recomputed all seven normative file SHA256 values and aggregate hash; confirmed designer-data spec digest, designer-docs spec/workflow byte equality, and both HTML embedded payloads match current generated data.

Independently read exact 162e572e remote clean-clone result and recomputed hashes of all 14 logs: checkout head and tree match, all exits 0, clean resulting worktree, status Pass. This establishes the documented cold-source governance/browser/package/generator route only.

evidence.aggregate_observation: Root-run integrated aggregates log reports 296 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. This review did not execute Cargo; log alone is not used to rebind the prior full language acceptance to 162e572e.

limits: A full current-source language default/reference/release matrix is not claimed by this scoped review; prior accepted-language results bind 498f0f5a and the integrated tree is proved equal in language source except the two reviewed test include paths.
